ICS 65.060

Agriculture and Food Processing Equipments Sectional Committee, FAD 20

FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Agriculture and Food Processing Equipments Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)'. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

IS 15855 : 2010

Indian Standard COTTON SEED DELINTING MACHINERY -- SURGE BIN MACHINE -- SPECIFICATION
1 SCOPE This standard specifies material, performance, constructional and other requirements of surge bin machine. 2 REFERENCES The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below: IS No. 1364 Title Hexagon head bolts, screws and nuts of product grades A and B: 3 TERMINOLOGY For the purpose of this standard following definitions shall apply. 3.1 Surge Bin Machine -- A machine used for equal distribution of fuzzy seed for temporary storage and prewarming before preheating machine. It distributes the lumps of fuzzy seed in the bin by tangential force of rotating disc at 30 rpm. It has perforated centrally fixed pipe through which the used heated air from preheating machine is used to increase the temperature of seed by 2 to 3�C. The surge bin machine holds the fuzzy seed and then discharge the seed to preheating machine by screw conveyor. The surge bin is fabricated with MS sheets and angles. The bin has hopper bottom to deliver the seed through screw conveyor. 3.2 Fuzzy Seed -- The cotton seed left over after separation of lint from seed cotton ( KAPAS ) by ginning operation. The cotton seed contains bollworm-affected seed, cut seed, inert matter, trash, oversize and undersize seed, which is not free flowing, due to fuzz over the seed. 3.3 Warm Seed -- This is fuzzy seed, which is heated by passing the hot air through perforated pipe centrally fixed in the surge bin machine. 3.4 Seed Distribution System -- This system distributes the lumps of fuzzy cottonseed in the surge bin machine by tangential force of rotating disc at 30 rpm. This operation is done to achieve the equal filling of fuzzy seed in surge bin. 3.5 Agitation System -- As the fuzzy seed is in the form of lumps, this system moves the lumps of the seed and allows the seed to fill in the surge bin evenly. 3.6 Pre-warming System -- This system helps to increase the temperature of seed through 2 to 3�C. This removes some percentage of moisture from the seed. 3.7 Screw Conveying System -- This operation is provided for transferring the fuzzy seed, which is temporarily held in the surge bin machine to the preheating machine. This screw is rotated by providing power through a motor of standard make, which rotate the screw at 30 rpm.

IS 15855 : 2010 3.8 Body -- This is a stationary machine, which is fixed on the level ground. This machine has screw conveyor at the hopper bottom and mechanical distribution system at top and perforated air pipe fixed in the mid of surge bin. 4 MATERIALS The material of construction of surge bin machine shall be given in the references. The material may conform to the relevant Indian Standards given in Table 1. Table 1 Material of Construction of Surge Bin Machine

7.4 The machine shall be provided with easy facilities for adjustments. 8 WORKMANSHIP 8.1 The components of the machine shall be free from crack and other visual defects. 8.2 The welding and joints, if any, shall not be porous and shall be smooth. 8.3 The corrosion preventing coating shall be provided to the body such FRP lining 2 mm thick shall be provided. 8.4 The control and adjustment provided shall be easy and operating smoothly. 9 MARKING AND PACKING 9.1 Marking Each surge bin machine shall be marked with the following particulars: a) Manufacturer's name and address; b) Type and model number; c) Power rating; d) Drive details; e) Batch or Code number, if any; and f) Year of manufacture. 9.1.1 Each surge bin may also be marked with the overall size and approximate weight of machine or this information may be given in the catalogue supplied by the manufacturer. 9.2 BIS Certification Marking Each surge bin machine may also be marked with the Standard Mark. 9.2.1 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act , 1986 and Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards. 9.3 Packing The packing of surge bin machine shall be done as agreed to between the supplier and the purchaser.

5 PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENT When tested with the method shall conform to the requirement given in Annex A. 6 CONSTRUCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS The sheets, plates and angles used in the construction of surge bin machine shall be depending on the capacity of the machine, vary from 3 mm, 5 mm, 8 mm and angles 25 mm� 25 mm, 35 mm � 35 mm and 50 mm � 50 mm. 7 OTHER REQUIREMENTS 7.1 The necessary bearing, chain sprocket and power drive shall be provided. 7.2 The necessary provision of greasing, oiling for bearings shall be provided. 7.3 The construction shall be such as to help and easy repairs and maintenance.

2

IS 15855 : 2010

ANNEX A (Clause 5)
METHODS OF TEST FOR SURGE BIN MACHINE A-1 RUNNING IN AND PRELIMINARY ADJUSTMENTS A-1.1 The surge bin machine shall be installed on levelled preferably on hard surface. A-1.2 The surge bin machine shall be run in for about 30 min before commencing the test. All the adjustments shall be carried out in accordance with the recommendations of the manufacturers. A-2 TEST AT NO LOAD After running in is over the surge bin machine shall be run at no load for 10 min at the specific speed. During and after the no load run the visual observation at the surge bin machine shall not show the following: a) Presence of any marked vibration during the operation. b) Presence of undue knocking sound or rattling sound. c) Any marked rise in the bearing temperature. d) Any marked unusual wear or slackness in any component. A-3 TEST AT LOAD The surge bin machine shall be operated at its input capacity specified by the manufacturer incorporating best combination of adjustment for a period of 30 min. During the running period revolution per minute of screw shall be noted. A-4 LONG RUN TEST The surge bin machine shall be operated for a minimum of 20 h duration. During and after the operation no breakdown or defects shall develop in the surge bin machine.
